name: M.Tech Project Part 2
description: This project-based course focuses on research, design, and development within the domain of intelligent and learning-based systems. The work may continue from Major Technical Project Part-1 and can be theoretical, computational, or experimental in nature. Students are expected to integrate foundational knowledge in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and intelligent hardware to formulate and implement innovative, data-driven solutions to real-world problems. The outcomes of the project shall be presented through a detailed technical report (thesis) and a formal presentation demonstrating analytical depth, originality, and impact.
